ui.hero.title: A single platform for every animal you are in charge of
ui.hero.sub: Files, daily operations and teamwork across all your sites. Find every task in Antz, with the real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Touch a card to open its guide, with all its features and its screens.
ui.cta.text: Each module is presented in this guide with its features and its real screens. Resume where you had stopped, or contact us and we will help you.
ui.day.title: Your first day on Antz
ui.day.2: Find your bearings in the interface
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles adapted to your organization and activate authorizations module by module, so that everyone sees what they need for their work.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on telephone and on computer?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile application covers field work, such as notes, treatments, transfers and egg recordings. The web application covers office work, such as the hospital system, the nursery configuration, reports and the pharmacy stock. Updates display in real time on telephone, tablet and computer.
ui.faq.q3: Can we control who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is based on roles. You create the roles used in your organization, for example Zoologist, and activate authorizations module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We manage several sites. Is that possible?
ui.faq.a4: Antz groups the data of all sites and departments in a single place. Housing is organized by site, section and enclosure, and movements between sites go through an approval and an exit check by security.
ui.faq.a5: Start with the First Steps guide, then open the modules used by your role. If something is not clear, write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Necropsy
m.necropsy.intro: The Necropsy module documents post-mortem examinations with detailed observations, findings by organ and medical conclusions. It allows a precise analysis of the cause of death, harmonizes reports, guarantees prompt handling of corpses and meets legal, audit and veterinary requirements.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filters
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by site, date, priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Follow the stages of the transfer [?]: Incoming, Pending, Draft and Finished.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request information
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, cause, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The Deworming module makes it possible to record and follow antiparasitic treatments systematically, guaranteeing administration in due time, rigorous documentation and clear follow-up of each deworming for each animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Views by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Dewormings sorted into Upcoming, Pending, Sautéed [?] and Finished for easy follow-up.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a treatment or directly record an administered medicine, with defined dates and details.
m.deworming.f3.title: Administration recording
m.deworming.f3.desc: Captures the dosage, the batch number, the route of administration, notes and a possible follow-up.
m.housing.title: Housing
m.housing.intro: The Housing module organizes the animals' habitats in your sites, sections and enclosures, so that each animal has a known location and each change is tracked. Access to each level depends on authorizations.
m.housing.f1.title: Site administration
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or modify sites with role-based authorizations, for secure and structured access.
m.housing.f2.title: Section administration
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or modify sections within the zoo, with authorization-based controls for safe administration.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure administration
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or modify enclosures and follow each of them for efficient supervision of animals and data.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal death
m.fetal-death.intro: The Fetal Death module records and manages cases of fetal death in the enclosures, noting the cause, the moment and the information on the animals concerned. It supports veterinary care, reproductive health monitoring, trend analysis and better management of populations.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Add a case of fetal death
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Note new cases: cause, moment, parentage, information on the animal.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filters
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by site, date, stillbirth or abortion, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: View the records of deaths
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full details, days since death, cause, identifier, enclosure, site, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The Eggs module follows the whole life cycle of eggs, from laying to hatching or transfer to the nursery, with accurate records, real-time updates and complete traceability for better coordination and accountability among the nest, nursery and hatchery teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Live totals: in nests, transferred to the nursery, marked for disposal.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg entry (nest / nursery)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parents, condition, dates, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and complete timeline of the egg's journey.
m.administer-medicine.title: Administration of medicines
m.administer-medicine.intro: The Administration module complements the Medical Records by transforming prescriptions into concrete treatment processes, to deliver care in real time to an animal or to a batch, in the field or at the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration record for a chosen date, without writing a full medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filters
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Quickly find records and refine the list by date, entity, species or controlled substance.
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatments by date in four tabs: Pending, Administered, Sautéed [?], Stopped [?].
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The Vaccination module manages the whole vaccination cycle of animals, from planning and direct administration to tracking upcoming, pending, sautéed [?] and finished vaccinations. It guarantees treatments in due time, an accurate recording of doses and complete traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Views by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations sorted into Upcoming, Pending, Sautéed [?] and Finished for easy follow-up.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule a vaccination or directly record an administered vaccine, with dates and details on the medicine.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Administration recording
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Captures the dosage, the batch number, the route of administration, notes and a possible follow-up.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Allows quick, accurate and traceable dispensing of medical products directly to authorized veterinarians, with processing of requests in due time and an automatic update of stocks from the prescription to the shelf, and visibility by batch and tracking of expiry dates throughout the process.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time indicators on stock problems, shipments, purchases, requests, consumption, expiry dates and high-turnover products, with visual trends to act fast.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filters
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly find records by request number, name of the veterinarian or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Reference data (racking and shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organize storage by number of racks/shelves for quick access and updates, with customizable data (packaging, unit of measure, salts [?], delivery people [?], manufacturers).
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Stock report management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Stock by batch with value and expiry; flag out-of-stock or expired items; monitor upcoming expiries; manage the sequestration [?] with dispute resolution.
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product and stock management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track stock and expiries, record purchases/shipments, keep a unified register, manage substitutes/variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Dispensing management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Veterinarians can prescribe and dispense, or collect medicines directly at the pharmacy, all of it recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Shipment management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing shipments of medicines and process them in the application.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock adjustments and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record stock variations (missing, broken, expired); keep the audit history; manage supplier returns; download reports on consumption, returns, purchases and dispensing for accounting and demand forecasting.
m.getting-started.title: First steps
m.getting-started.intro: The First Steps guide presents the purpose of the application and accompanies new users through the essential steps: setting up their profile, discovering the key features and navigating the platform efficiently.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and workspaces
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Connect securely and access your assigned work environment.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home feed for news, the quick navigation shortcuts and the bottom panel for the main tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Necropsy / Administration / Assignment pending
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals awaiting necropsy, administrative documentation, then assignment or disposal before the final closure of the records.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Reference configuration and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Configure the reference data and discover modules such as Medical Records, Housing, Eggs, Feeding and Animal Management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalization
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage your notes, update your profile and set your language preferences.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Authorizations
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand the access levels needed for secure operations.
